cross_release_comparison.summary: Apart from fields that identify the binaries (actinv_module, prune_probe, probe and dump binary hashes, record fingerprints derived from them, and the FNG normalized_result_sha256 of a solver output that carries the solver identity), work-directory paths, cache counters, the cgroup scope name and peak resident set, the only difference is the expected one: the W, 7 h default-outputs run without pruning, which stopped with an index error on 1.6.0, completes on 1.6.1. No computed value differs.

not_meeting_repeat_rule.s6: peak resident set only; every count, hash and failure message repeats
